name: 20603 · Waldorf, MD
findings: ZIP 20603 (Waldorf) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20603 (Waldorf) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
